sentences.text: Little Dorrit is a novel by Charles Dickens , originally published in serial form between 1855 and 1857 .	Charles Dickens	Charles Dickens	novel	novel	serial	Serial (literature)

It satirises the shortcomings of both government and society , including the institution of debtors ' prisons , where debtors were imprisoned , unable to work , until they repaid their debts .	satirises	satirises
The prison in this case is the Marshalsea , where Dickens 's own father had been imprisoned .	Marshalsea	Marshalsea

Dickens is also critical of the lack of a social safety net , the treatment and safety of industrial workers , as well the bureaucracy of the British Treasury , in the form of his fictional `` Circumlocution Office '' .	social safety net	social safety net	Treasury	HM Treasury
In addition he satirises the stratification of society that results from the British class system .	satirises	satirises	British class system	British class system
